scope: macOS resident-memory sampler overhead reduction; mixed SQL results and no broad throughput win
change: Replace ps subprocess polling with libproc proc_pidinfo TaskInfo resident bytes; keep 100-ms interval and memory checks unchanged

live_profile.load: 18-second two-client prepared oltp_read_write sysbench run, profiling starts two seconds into load; excluded from throughput comparisons
live_profile.result: Memory sampler still reaches handle_runtime_stats; no Command::output or posix_spawn frames. Thread-state samples outside sleep: before 175/6302, after 4/6321. Not a CPU-time or throughput measurement.

microbenchmark.command: cd rust && cargo test --offline --locked --release -j12 -p tidb-util --lib process_rss_sampling_cost -- --ignored --nocapture
microbenchmark.conclusion: All five native samples are cheaper; approximately 4686x lower median wall time per RSS read. This is not an end-to-end throughput claim.

correctness.red_result: PATH-isolated child fails with NotFound under the old subprocess implementation
correctness.green_command: cd rust && cargo test --offline --locked --release -j12 -p tidb-util --lib cgroup::tests
correctness.green_result: 12 tests passed; manual microbenchmark ignored and then passed separately with process-inspection permission
correctness.coverage: No command dependency, touched-page resident-byte growth, existing cgroup parsers and platform-independent limit logic; manual native-versus-ps byte comparison
correctness.live_sql_result: Seven live locking cases passed on the new release server

tpcc.conclusion: Mixed paired results at both concurrencies. Two-client median increases 1.11 percent, eight-client median declines 5.50 percent; Rust remains behind Go. No broad workload speedup. Shared evolving data and time-seeded TPC-C inputs remain measurement limitations. No builds, profiles, or other workloads overlapped.

sysbench_paired.command: python3 rust/scripts/compare-sysbench.py --server before:53010 --server after:53011 --database perf_sysbench_locking_v2 --workload oltp_read_write --threads 2 --seconds 20 --rounds 3 --table-size 100000 --output /private/tmp/tidb-native-rss-sysbench-paired
sysbench_paired.conclusion: After wins one pair and loses two; median is 1.09 percent lower. No sysbench throughput win. No builds, profiles, or other workloads overlapped.

sysbench_three_endpoints.diagnosis: Go tidb.log at 2026-09-07 03:25:36 and INFORMATION_SCHEMA.DEADLOCKS confirm error 1213 between transactions 468902933068513322 and 468902933068513323 on UPDATE sbtest1 SET c=? WHERE id=?
sysbench_three_endpoints.conclusion: One error-free Rust pair is insufficient. Preserve the Go error and do not claim a complete throughput result. A separately declared three-round paired Rust experiment isolates sampler impact, not Go-relative performance.
